activity_statements.statement: operates the world's largest real estate franchise network with approximately 136,511 agents holding approximately 20.4% US market share by transaction sides and volume
recruits, trains, and supports independent real estate agents through large-territory market centers designed for 150+ agents that share fixed costs
operates a profit-sharing program distributing a portion of market center operating profit to agents based on their recruiting activity across seven levels
facilitates residential real estate transactions (buying, selling, and renting) through its agent network using proprietary KW technology tools and the KW app
provides Keller Home Loans mortgage services to help buyers secure financing and make competitive offers in the residential market

name_reality_gap: The name 'Keller Williams' sounds like a boutique brokerage; in reality it is the world's largest real estate franchise by agent count. The corporate entity primarily operates a training and technology franchise system — agents are independent contractors, not employees. Revenue comes from franchise fees, not commissions on individual transactions.
extraction_notes: kw.com about page returned limited content (primarily a property search interface). Our-history page returned same limited content. Careers page timed out. Agent count and market share figures sourced from ExaAnswer research synthesis citing public sources. Profile relies partly on third-party data.
